explanation: From main: workflows.md changed only in its ui-change route (lazy views and test preloading). The dataset-change route, its builders, registry rules, bundle checks and contracts are unchanged, and no dataset, bundle or registry file was touched. From the cross-study listing: No dataset registration, bundle builder, sidecar or query index format changed. The row builders add a tier derived from the q and p they already read, so a dataset change still produces the same bundles and index shards; only how the views order and label those rows moved into src/statistics.
